name: RESET YOUR ACCESS
purpose: Let the person choose a new password, and tell them what to do if they did not ask.

eligibility: Reset requested on F01.05 for an existing account
trigger.duplicateGuard: Provider-owned (Supabase Auth); one active recovery link per address

copy.subject: Reset your JURNL password
copy.preheader: Use this link to choose a new password. If you did not ask, ignore this email.
copy.replyToPolicy: Replies reach monitored support. The footer says JURNL will never ask for a password or code by email.
copy.headline: RESET YOUR ACCESS.
body: We received a request to reset the password for {recipientEmail}.
